question: Who led the 'Bardoli Satyagraha' in 1928?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bardoli Satyagraha** was a major episode of civil disobedience and revolt in the Indian Independence Movement.
 
• Its leadership by **Vallabhbhai Patel** marked him as one of the foremost leaders in Gujarat.
 
• The movement began in response to the British government increasing taxes by 30% on the land of Bardoli.
 
• **Patel** and his volunteers organised the farmers, urging them to refuse payment of the increased tax, despite severe governmental repression.
 
• The success of this movement led to the recovery of confiscated lands and properties, and Patel was henceforth known as **Sardar Patel**.
